sections.Profile:
Black Pyramid , released by Bally in July 1984, is a four-player solid-state game with an Egyptian adventure theme, designed by George Christian with art by Greg Freres and software by Rehman Merchant. A swinging target sits in the center of the playfield, and a bank of three in-line drop targets raises the bonus multiplier.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1984

- Type: Solid State
